correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 each vertex has exactly three distinct neighbors; unequal rung requires horizontal agreement on both sides and propagates around the cycle, hence only the two globally separated states. Equal rungs reduce exact fixedness to forbidding isolated cyclic words. Marked-run compositions counted with n/r multiplicity give full mass spectrum. Even independent edge subsets of a cycle, evaluated by a 2x2 transfer-matrix trace at z=+1 and -1, give Lucas plus 2cos(nπ/3). These steps prove the infinite result. Independently coded exhaustive brute-force tests for n=3..9 and exact mass-sum checks through n=200 passed 40,688 comparisons; these do not substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The full equilibrium opinion-balance spectrum, including a sharp minimal surviving minority size and exponential abundance, is a natural structural invariant of the simplest degree-three vertex-transitive extension of a social influence cycle. Adding a rung removes tie-breaking and changes random-majority fixed-state abundance from two to exponential; the exact normalized blue-count distribution and rigidity classification go beyond the known asymptotic cycle result. This is not an arbitrary finite table or a claim about practical outcomes. It does not determine attraction probabilities or metastable cycles.
